target.title: fix: contributor avatar no longer stretches README rows
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the README contributor wall could render one avatar at its full intrinsic size when GitHub's avatar CDN ignored the requested `s=48` query parameter. The oversized image stretched its row and pushed the remaining contributor wall down the page.

## Why This Change Was Made

The contributor generator now emits linked HTML images with explicit `width="48"` and `height="48"` attributes for every visible contributor. This makes sizing a markup invariant instead of relying on CDN resizing, while preserving profile links and safely escaping display names. The generated README has been refreshed to the same format.

## User Impact

All contributor avatars render consistently, including current and future avatars whose source image ignores GitHub's requested size. Contributor names and profile links are preserved.

## Evidence

- Live inspection found `constansino`'s requested 48 px avatar rendering at its intrinsic 420×420 size.
- Generated README audit: 648 contributor links, 648 images, zero images missing 48×48 dimensions.
- `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run test/scripts/update-clawtributors.test.ts` — 5 tests passed.
- `node node_modules/oxfmt/bin/oxfmt --check scripts/update-clawtributors.ts test/scripts/update-clawtributors.test.ts README.md` — passed.
- `node node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.scripts.json scripts/update-clawtributors.ts` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.

AI-assisted implementation; the behavior and generated output were manually inspected and validated.
